name: Encounter with God
shortDescription: A Scripture Union mobile Bible-reading app for daily, in-depth study, combining Scripture, theological exposition, articles and spiritual reflections.
suitableContexts: Individuals seeking structured, deeper daily Bible study
Church leaders or small groups signposting a common devotional resource
Readers who value scholarly exposition alongside daily Bible passages

pricing.summary: Scripture Union's current app page establishes the product but does not publish a clear subscription price, purchase route, free access scope or cancellation terms in the reviewed material. Check the current iOS or Android store listing and subscription terms before recommending it as a paid resource.

gdprInformation: Scripture Union publishes a UK privacy notice covering its apps and online accounts. It identifies Scripture Union as an English and Welsh registered charity and company, describes account and app-related personal-data collection, and notes that some information may be transferred outside the EEA. The reviewed material does not establish app-specific account, purchase, analytics, sub-processor, retention or export arrangements; avoid using it to collect church pastoral or sensitive information.
integrations: No church-management, group, giving or pastoral-data integrations are documented in the reviewed material
importExport: No public study-note, bookmark or account-data export specification was found
support: Scripture Union publishes contact and privacy-preference routes
App-specific support and subscription support should be confirmed through the current app-store listing

uk-operator.value: Scripture Union identifies itself as a charity registered in England and Wales (213422) and a company limited by guarantee (00039828).

product-scope.value: Supplier describes Encounter with God as a mobile Bible-reading app for in-depth exploration, daily readings, scholarly articles and spiritual insights.

privacy.value: Supplier's privacy notice covers online accounts and apps, states its UK organisation identity and discusses personal-data processing, supplier controls and potential transfers outside the EEA.

editorial.assessment: Encounter with God is a focused daily-study app from a longstanding UK Scripture-engagement charity. Its stated emphasis is deeper Bible exploration rather than church administration or collaborative group facilitation. It can be useful as a personal or recommended resource, but a church should treat the current subscription, account and app-data details as individual-user decisions rather than attempt to manage members through the product.
bestFor: Adults who want a structured and more in-depth daily Bible-reading rhythm
Church leaders who want to signpost a UK charity-operated study resource
People looking for theological reflection alongside a daily reading plan
strengths: Current supplier page identifies a dedicated deeper-study mobile app
Accountable UK charity and published organisation-wide app privacy notice
Clear distinction from a general church-management platform
limitations: Not a collaborative small-group, pastoral-record, safeguarding or church-management tool
Current price, subscription and cancellation terms require checking in the relevant app store
No public integration or export specification found
Organisation-wide privacy information is not a substitute for app-specific data documentation

procurementVerdict.problem: Supporting a regular, deeper individual Bible-study rhythm
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK Scripture Union app specifically positioned around daily scholarly yet accessible Bible exploration
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Ask a small number of adult readers to test the reading style and app accessibility, then check current store pricing, subscription and privacy details before promoting it as a church-wide recommendation
